common.tagline: Free PDF tools in your browser

home.title: Free PDF tools online
home.subtitle: Merge, split, rotate and convert to images — fast, secure and with no upload.
home.intro: PDF Tools is a free online platform for the most common PDF tasks. Whether you want to merge, split, rotate or convert documents to images, every tool runs fast and securely right in your browser.
home.securityNote: Your files never leave your browser. Everything runs locally on your device.
home.toolsSubheading: All tools run entirely in your browser.

faq.question: Are my files secure?
faq.answer: Yes. All PDFs are processed locally in your browser only. Files are never uploaded to a server.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes, every tool is permanently free to use, with no registration.

faq.question: Do I need to sign up?
faq.answer: No. You can use any tool instantly, without an account or login.

faq.question: Which operating systems are supported?
faq.answer: Because everything runs in the browser, the tools work on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS.

faq.question: How large can a PDF be?
faq.answer: Processing happens on your device. Very large files depend on your available memory; most documents are fine.
